# speckit dismiss

<!-- generated by `speckit generate commands` -->

Dismissal memory for advisory findings (feature 037, ADR-0058, FR-004): record first per-machine triage verdict against first content-bound finding identity, list current dismissals, or undo one

## Usage

```text
Usage: speckit dismiss [OPTIONS] [FAMILY] [FINDING_ID]
```

`--json` prints one JSON object enabled stdout.

## Help

```text
speckit dismiss --help
```
